The crystals are the same size as previous Himalayan salt that we purchased in the past, which is coarser than regular table salt. When described as finely ground, I was expecting smaller sized crystals. Our usual supplier is in stock again, so I probably won't be purchasing this brand again if not necessary. But the price is pretty good and the quality seems fine, so I would recommend this to people who are looking to try Himalayan salt.

I am only reviewing the Bacon flavor, but my dogs picked up on how this works pretty quickly and love the taste of it.  At first they wanted to bite the bottle and chew it like a treat but I worked with them for about a minute or so and they got down that you only lick it.  I have 3 dogs and all three of them liked the taste of it.  I like it because it seems like a more personal treat than just a dog biscuit.  I recommend this!

For quite some time, I have been using different types of hot sauce on different types of food.  Before I started doing this, I only ever remember using hot sauce on barbeque sandwiches.  Even though I have tried numerous types of hot sauce during this period, Paula Deen Collection Hot Sauce has set itself apart from the others and has become a favorite.  I made up my mind about this product only after using it once on a particular item of food.  The overall flavor of this hot sauce is pleasing--I like its saltiness and tanginess, for example.  Also, it is neither too hot nor too mild.  Paula Deen Collection Hot Sauce is a product that I can recommend.

Olives and tortilla chips...who ever though such a combo would be so good? No trans fats, not overly salty, nothing artifical (like the label says...) makes for something a bit different that your typical tortilla chip.

You don't need any salsa or cheese on top of them -- the flavor is perfect (if you like the taste of green olives, that is.) You'll be asking for more as the 1 oz. bag will not be enough!
Best Kalamata Olives I've ever had with a hint of spice. Very easy to travel with and even easier to eat.I wish Amazon would keep more of these in stock.

Summary: Good for boxed mac n cheese.
Text: Healthier alternative to other boxed mac n cheeses. I would recommend to anybody who enjoys a quick and easy mac n cheese.

Skyy likes this toy. It took her a while to figure out who to move the spinner toy, but once she got it, there was no stopping her. It's not as exciting for as her Smart Toys IQ Treat Ball, but she still gets excited when she sees me filling it. She runs to the rug where, I usually put it, and she has fun pushing it to get her treasures out. A great entertaining, and stimulating, toy for any dog! Highly recommend!

We like the ranch and bacon flavor, but it is not what we usually think of when we think pasta salad. We think of something more Italian than ranch when we have pasta.  Try it, though.  You may love it if you are fond of ranch flavors.

Yes I know this says Dove for Men and I'm a girl but you know, it was in the shower so I was like, what the heck, soap's soap right? Also seeing as how my husband will use my girly body washes, I felt no guilt in using his. Well in all basic necessities, it did it's job, I got clean and smelled nice.  The smells not too overpowering nor did I smell like a dude unlike some other body washes who shall not be named.  Maybe guys aren't used to the "grains" to exfoliate but I liked them.  For a quick rinse shower, I could see how they could be a bother when you're trying to get in/out really fast and frantically trying to brush it off. But if you're taking your time in the shower, scrubbing with the beads was quite nice.  Husband likes it as well.  He really likes how there are now MEN lines in body washes and shampoos.  It's about time that companies realize that guys DO care about how they look and will take care of themselves.  Overall we enjoyed the product. It may say MEN but it can be totally unisex in a pinch.

I LOVE sunflower seeds. Always have. Rather than waste half a large bag (They go bad fast in my house) I can just grab a snack sized one. The only problem I have with this is that I ordered two buckets, thats 120 packages, and they expire before the end of this year!!! I'm going to eat them later anyways, however I was expecting a later expiration date.

Stash is a decent brand of tea. We've got a number of their varieties in the house. We only use loose leaf and this doesn't have that tendency you sometimes get in loose leaf to be teeny tiny powder bits. You can actually tell that this was, at one time, a plant.

It's got a good mild flavour that is just right near bedtime.

Summary: White or brown rice flour? It matters big time!
Text: I wish some of these companies would say whether the rice is white or brown rice. I try very hard to just eat the whole grain version of any grain as they are more nutrient dense(plus lower glycemic). I've not tried this yet, but if it was listed as brown rice flour, I would have put it in my cart.

Summary: Good food toy for the rotation
Text: This toy has worked out well for our dog!  We try to buy interesting and safe toys for us to give her while we're at work. It's tough and has withstood our large Bernese Mountain dog puppy chewing at the neck of it and throwing it around the room. It took her a few days to figure it out.  I had to show her how to use it, and she seemed uninterested, but then I left it in her crate with her, and when I came home later it was empty.  Since then, she's a pro at it.  The rope didn't last that long, but we just took the rope out and use larger treats with it, and it's still a challenge for her.  Our last thing that we tried in it was baby carrots - she loved it and it took her a good 30 minutes to get them out.

Love, love, love! The smell of the coffee packs! When I got this and opened it, honestly, the aroma was just so amazing, it is one of the best smelling coffees I have ever smelled!

If only that taste transferred over.... Unfortunately, when I actually made the coffee, it wasn't extremely flavorful, not was it as dark and rich as I would have hoped. In fact, it taste a little more like nutty coffee flavored tea, which isn't bad, I love tea! But if I was coffee, I usually want something that taste strong. I have had plenty of non-expresso coffees that are rich and almost thick, but this is not one of them.

It is a good light coffee, I suppose if you don't want something too strong, maybe to have with some cookies or muffins at tea time (not a lot of Americans have tea time, but if you do...), it is a nice coffee for that, since it is not too overpowering, it works well in that way.

As long as, when you get this, you know its not a super rich, strong coffee, I think you will enjoy it, its just all about expectations.

God Bless ~Amy

I wasn't sure what to expect with the Wolfgang Puck coffees, but I am pleased.

The Sorrento is a good medium roast. It is a bit darker of a roast than some of the other mediums out in Keurig-land, but it isn't bitter. There's just a little of something chocolatey in the flavor.

My only complaint is that this coffee, like most of the Keurig cups that don't say "extra bold" on them, they brew up pretty weak if you do a larger mug. I typically brew the 9.25 oz size, and on these guys I bumped it down to the 7.25 oz size. If I brew it in the larger cups, it just comes out too weak.

If you are one who feels that K-cups usually make weak coffee, you will think that these are really weak, and be tempted to brew 'em two at a time. This coffee is not plain or unflavorvful -- there's just less coffee in the K-cup (or rather the normal, not extra-bold amount), so it brews up weaker.
Very good coffee, not too bold, but rich.  Took a long time to ship, so order early!

The Fudge Drizzle Caramel popcorn is really yummy -- the caramel is sweet but not cloying and the popcorn is satisfyingly crunchy. However, like so many SnackWell products, this is NOT a low calorie snack considering the calories to fullness ratio -- my daughter put away three bags in fifteen minutes as her after school snack after a long hard day at school. This wouldn't matter a great deal except that the price of this treat -- five small bags in a box -- makes them more of a every-now-and-then treat rather than a house staple.

The box is really pretty though. The green made me feel good about opening the cardboard box. And that's what it's supposed to do, right? ;)

So I'd finally recommend these if 1) you're not THAT hungry and 2) you have a lot of money you are wanting to get out.

Taste is really good -- so I can see the argument for these. Worth four stars but only if criteria 1 and 2 work for you.

I really miss those Sunshine Lemon Coolers!!! Niches has these and they are as close as you are going to get to the old Sunshine brand. They do not have the really sweet tart impact on your taste buds as the Sunshine Coolers had but they are a close 2nd and worth the money. I just ordered my second pack of 6 and I highly recommend these.
Get them now as we do not know when another good thing will be terminated as the Sunshine coolers were.
A friend of mine sent me some of theese, and I thought it sounded kinda gross. But found they were quite good for a snack, but the only place I've found them on the west coast is online

This is quite a unique brand of cat food. Their tagline is "People food for cats" and they are quite right. They smell and look delicious.

There are basically two types of canned cat food in my experience, the first kind is the solid kind where you tip the can into the plate and the food retains the shape of the can. The second type is the more liquidy type that you can spoon, almost pour into the cats plate. For me this second type is preferable because it has a higher content of liquid which I consider to be healthier for the cats urinary system. This cat food is of this second type.

My cat is a very finicky eater and he takes time to adjust to new foods.
This package contains two flavors; the first is chicken pot pie which looks just like real chicken pot pie, right down to the light gravy, there are cubes of real chicken breast and it really looks like pot pie. My cat laps up all the sauce then moves on to the chunks of chicken.

Second flavor is sesame chicken: This smells really good and the chicken is not chunked but in thin strips. My cat loves the sauce and will drain it all dry but is not too fond of the chicken. He will probably adjust to it over time. This is why only four stars.
This is the single hottest thing I've ever ingested! The flavor wasn't very appealing, though. If you like it hot, fine...but if you like it PAINFULLY HOT, this stuff is for you!

I had been using creamy peanut butter and a touch of sesame oil in place of tahini (since I couldn't find it in any stores in my town) when making hummus. However, the consistency, smell and taste was always a bit off. I opened the jar when it arrived and it was perfect. I can't wait to try some in my next batch of hummus! It is definitely worth paying a little more for a better culinary result.

This chestnut roaster is very good.  It keeps enough moisture in the roaster to keep the chesnuts moist, but still enables you to get the flavor of roasting instead of boiling.  It is a bit small though, since most people roast chestnuts on holidays, I usually have to do a few batches to get a good enough portion done.  Easy to clean.
I like this green tea. It is placed in special polyester tea bag, which makes brewing easy. The Kirkland logo should be enough guarantee for quality, at least for me (I am Big fan of Costco.)
I ordered this by mistake.  I wanted the seasoned rice vinegar not the one for sushi.  It isn't too bad, rather salty but that is probably what you need for a vinegar for sushi.

Great stuff and dependable, especially when there are a million brands "out there" to choose from.  I love the stuff.  For really high end desires, I go with the Apollo Olive Oils from California.  But I buy a whole lot more of this stuff and will buy it again and again.

Summary: Fits Senseo but pods broken in bag
Text: I too have been searching for Senseo pods for months and finally decided to try another brand. I think the Senseo pods are now coming back in stock btw.  These do fit the senseo and the taste is good. However, out of the 3 packages, 2 had pods that had broken inside and spilled grounds all over the other pods.  This is inconvenient and messy.  I did order another set to see if this was a fluke but lots of other reviewers have experienced the same thing. If I get more broken pods, I will switch back to the Senseos now that they seem to be available in limited selections.

I really did like this one for it has my two favorite things when it comes to a cereal: Crunchy & Sweet. I didn't think the flavor was too overdone and I could taste the vanilla just fine. In fact I tend to eat cereal with soy milk and sometimes even vanilla soy milk so I really got a huge shot of vanilla. My hubby really liked it as well and he tends to like super sugar sweet cereals and thought this was just right maybe not even sweet enough for him. This might not be for everyone since people tend to like different things but I everyone in my home really enjoyed it and so might you.
Double Black Diamond has a very full bodied flavor, yet it's not too bitter. K-cups are a convenient way to get your morning cup of coffee without having to stop at the local Starbucks.

The flavor is very good in this kind, but does it ever pack a punch. With creamer and sweetener in it, it helps alot. When I got my CBTL Briosa, I bought a bunch of these capsules in varying flavors. Some are better than others, but I still love most of them and my machine.

Lives up to it's name.  It tastes sweeter than 120 calories and 1 gram of fat (zero saturated fat).  The crunch and the sweet taste reminds me a bit of the frosted flakes I ate as a kid.  It starts really crunchy and stays crunchy for a good while.  It's a little sweet for me as a daily cereal and it doesn't have the vitamin value of my regular cereal,  Total Raisen Bran, but will make a nice change from my daily routine.  It tastes great right out of the box as a snack.  NOTE: It does contain peanuts for those of you that are allergic to them.

Summary: FINEST BLEND OF sTROGANOFF IN DELICIOUS SAUCE
Text: Outstanding gourmet taste: the blend of mushrooms, steak and sauce is tantalyzing.  The orders could be divided, so that the entire order doen't have to be defrosted at once.  Possibly divide the large portion into three or four smaller ones. As it stands the order is easily microwavable.
I would not describe this popcorn as cheese, but it kind of grows on you and does have a good flavor.  It's just not cheese.
this was a great product at a great price, i would recommend it to everyone that uses the kcups. its a great product

Summary: Great taste, others may be sweeter
Text: THis product was great in my tea.  However, I do think I used more than when I was ordered the Source Naturals brand (which I got from IHerb.com).  Great sweetness and no aftertaste in my morning tea.

After not having access to a kitchen while in my law school's dorms last year, I was happy this year to have an apartment where I could bake again. Unfortunately, I found out when classes started again that one of my dear friends had discovered over the summer that she has a gluten intolerance. Since I bake to share, I resolved to find a way to bake for her as well. I found Bob's Red Mill flour at the grocery store and figured I'd give it a shot; I didn't realize I'd need xanthan gum, so it took a second trip to the store before I was actually ready to bake. Everything I've made so far has turned out perfectly. I haven't noticed a strong bean flavor at all, even when making a white cake for my friend's birthday last week. It didn't turn out quite as fluffy as I would have hoped, but it tasted fine and was plenty moist. (It was a new recipe anyway, so that could be why.) Overall I've been pleased with the product and its availability. While I kind of wish they'd just include the xanthan gum, they do recommend different amounts for different baked goods so I can understand why they'd sell it separately (beyond the obvious potential moneygrubbing reasons).
Overall, a very good brand of store-bought cookiees. Nothing beats fresh homemade cookies, of course, but if you don't have the time, these cookies are actually pretty tasty.

I had bought these for a juice fast I was trying, but I couldn't always make fresh juices at work. These are satisfying and great in a pinch. I wish I could find some of the "low sodium" at a decent price, but these are still less than regular V8. They are pretty tasty, like drinking Spaghettios. They are pretty satisfying overall.

I am very impressed with the Senseo coffee system. I have tried several of the coffees available and all are good, especially the Vienna. Its not as rich as the Bold roasts of Starbucks but its still an awesome cup of Brew. The Dark roast is quite rich and aromatic. Try it, you'll like it.

Well, I have got to say that these did nothing to curb my appetite.  The reason for the four stars is that they are a delicious low calorie treat.  I absolutely love them.  It's like eating a little candy bar and even if you eat two, you are only eating 60 calories.  They are really so good.  I carry a couple in my purse so that when I get a craving for chocolate, I can just pop one in my mouth.  The caramel is chewy and it's not a bite that you eat in two seconds so even though they didn't really curb the appetite, they helped me stay away from the Snickers!!

Kashi Go Lean is still the same delicious crunchy cereal. However there is a new smaller box with a reduced amount of cereal at a slightly reduced price. The good: box takes up less space!  The bad: don't expect the same amount of cereal in the box. BTW, has fewer calories and sugar than Go Lean Crunch.

Sometimes you want a snack with a little substance (albeit mechanically seperated chicken and MSG), and Slim Jim's satisfy that craving. I polished off the box in about a month and I don't regret the purchase one bit. You probably should go easy on them if you buy them though. Whatever spicy juice or grease these things are packed with can become unpleasant if you go through more than 3 or 4 of these in a short period. I averaged about 3 a day and sometimes it was just what i needed to shut my stomach up during a boring meeting.

I can't find the "Sugar-Free" version of this in my local supermarkets. So, hello Amazon! I have been drinking Carnation Instant Breakfast for years, I bet 20 years at least. It mixes easily with milk, even skim milk. However, I have cut back on as much sugar as I can. Now I mix it with Blue Diamond Unsweetened Almond Milk and it doesn't come out as well. I have to slowly pour in the powder while stirring vigorously, and I still get small chunks that won't mix. But at least my blood sugar is down. I was surprised at the amount of sugar in milk!
Anyway, it still is the easiest and most satisfying breakfast for weekdays. It keeps me full at least until lunch.

Summary: good for capsules, too - success depends on flavor
Text:
I got these because my local store was out of the capsule size in beef flavor. I discovered that they work just as well for big capsules, if you use your fingers to press the treat around them. My dog is very picky and yet he gets the capsule wrapped in this pocket without a problem. This suits me fine, since the tablet pockets are cheaper.

I took one star off because the ingredients are questionable, lots of chemicals, color, corn syrup and other crap. If my dog were not that old that his comfort is more important to me than his health, I honestly wouldn't go near them.

Also, he will not touch the duck flavor, though, but I reviewed this flavor separately.

I have used these oats tons since I bought a case. They make very good cookies and a good bowl of morning oatmeal too.  I experiment with raisens, cinnamon, maple syrup...I love buying from Amazon in case amounts too, it is super easy.

This is bottled water with caffeine in it in stylish bottle.

If thats what you're looking for it works as advertised.

You will probably be taken by surprise in terms of how much caffeine is in it - I had someone stop by my office for an hourlong meeting and he drank a whole bottle, he was completely wired.

I usually just keep a single bottle on my desk for sipping throughout the day.

My cats really seem to like this food. It does look like people food (the tuna and shrimp variety even has little shrimps in it). It is quite a bit more expensive than my usual brand of canned cat food (Fancy Feast), but it obviously contains whole seafood, which Fancy Feast does not.

I dinged it one star because it is very watery, but otherwise I have no complaints. Unlike some canned cat foods, Petite Cuisine does not smell bad (as long as you don't mind a fishy smell). I would buy this again if I saw it on sale, but I probably wouldn't pay full price for it.

This is the most unique dog treat I've seen. The liquid treat is dispensed from a container that reminds me of a large lip gloss tube with a roller. I've given this unique dog treat "4 stars" instead of five as an average based on the varied reactions from my two small dogs. The smaller Malti-poo loved the treat and from his reaction would give it "5 stars". He immediately licked the roller, received the treat, and wanted more. Our Cavalier King Charles Spaniel is a pickier eater in general and wouldn't even try it at first. He finally did, but didn't seem to like it. We have the chicken flavor and it may be he just didn't like the flavor.

Since our Malti-poo likes it so much, I have just ordered the three-pack that has chicken, liver, and bacon flavors. The three-pack is a better value than the individual packs and I'm hoping our Cavalier will like one of the other flavors better than the chicken. This is a unique idea to reward dogs with a treat without filling them up like traditional dog treats.

** Update: I ordered the three-pack and my Cavalier definitely likes the bacon flavor much better than chicken!
Ive been using this brand for a number of years, and have found it to be very good.  Cook's Illustrated has recommended it as the best yeast that it has tested.

Summary: Good for small pruning events, not for trimming bushes
Text:
I picked these up for $4.50 shipped, and quickly received my money's worth of usage. Easy to carry in the pocket in the locked position.

Handles up to 1/4" twigs just fine. But if you try trimming a whole bush like I did (Viburnim), it gets tiring, especially since it's easy to bump the lever into the locked position by mistake. I think I'll get an extension cord for my electric trimmer next time around.

Best for some occasional pruning jobs. Can do more, but not really the best tool.

With all the hoopla, I decided to give this a try, without any great expectations. I was expecting this to be very bland, but surprisingly it wasn't.  I thought it was pretty medium in taste and not bad at all.

These are some of the best cookies that I have ever eaten.  You would never know that they was sugar free.  My only problem that I had was that my box had been opened and re-taped, and was short 8 packs.  But other then that, I highly recommend these, if you like lemon cookies.  Jeff

Summary: Great alternative to making it all from scratch.
Text: Recently found this product after finding out I was gluten-intolerant. This is a great way to start if you do like to bake but do not want to take on buying all the ingredients needed to bake gluten-free. The box does not last long but so far this has worked well in all the usual recipes I cooked with when I was using regular flour.

Love the product on the whole but the packaging was sub-par basically a ziplock bag with one freeze pack that had melted by the time I received the box, some insulation in the box and multiple freeze packs would ensure the meat arrives still chilled and not hot.

Summary: different from all the other poultry seasonings
Text:
I have used this seasoning in chicken soup for several years and it adds just the right bit
of flavor to the soup. No other brand works as well. It is OK on baked chicken, etc but
try it in soup and I am sure you will agree
This makes a delicious cold drink. We keep a pitcher in the refrigerator for most of the summer. Not carried in grocery stores in my area.
pretty good seeds make nummy rolls and lemon poppy seed cakes that are sooo delicious we share them with our co workers...increasing our popularity...thanks chefs wherehouse!!!

Summary: Nice product, tastes like brown sugar but smells different
Text:
So, there really is nothing wrong with this product. I didn't buy it because I'm avoiding sugar (it would be healthy of me to cut back, of course and I am trying) I bought it because it's made from coconut and that sounded delicious, exotic and new. I gave it four out of five stars because it doesn't'wow' me.

I love trying new foods, especially ones that I can use in baking. Since I've had this coconut sugar I have used it in the following things;

1. Green Onion Naan - Naan is a yeasted bread, so I only needed two teaspoons of sugar to speed up the proofing stage, I subbed coconut sugar for the reg granulated sugar and the naan turned out just like they always do, puffy and flavorfull.

2. On a bowl of oatmeal - Again it tasted just the same, possibly because I included a liberal sprinkling of cinnamon and nutmeg, the subtleties of the sugar might have been overpowered by the spices?

3. Mixed into a cup of Tea with cream - ughh, something was not right, but then again, I use white sugar in my tea, never brown, so maybe the effect would have been the same -- tea dumped down the sink.

4. In a pan of green curry chicken - the curry tasted like it always does, yummy.

I guess if you are thinking of buying this because you imagine it will impart a subtle coconut fragrance to your food, think again, I thought it tasted just like brown sugar, so tasty and sweet, but nothing new. As for the health benefits, well, that I am unsure of. I don't believe it would be any safer for diabetics than a spoonful of sugar.

Summary: Don't be decieved by appearances- these are delicious!
Text:
I've been a huge Jelly Belly fan all my life, but as jelly beans go, they're too expensive for regular indulgence. Belly Flops can be quite ugly, but they retain the intense and interesting flavors of their more attractive brethren. The only differences are cosmetic, generally in shape and size, and the lower price point.

My only caveat is that the flavor distribution is irregular; you will almost certainly not get the full range of flavors, and several flavors (presumably those with particular problems on the production line) will predominate. The last batch I bought had quite a few of the Sours flavors, while the one before that had no Sours at all. Fortunately, there are only a few flavors that I dislike, but if you're pickier, this product might be too much of a gamble.

The review for this product alone is going to be short: it is effective, but tastes awful and bitter. I ordered this product to focus on studying, etc but I found that "get charged" is just as effective plus wakes me up a bit more and tastes a whole lot better. If you are considering "get smart", I would strongly suggest trying "get charged" first. I have inserted my review for "get charged" below so you can see why...

"'Get charged' works wonders and tastes amazing, even without sugar, whether hot or cold. I ordered a cup of this on a whim while working on application essays for grad school. I figured (especially being caffeine free) that it would just be a gimmick and that I'd just move onto a latte afterward. Well...I never needed the latte. This woke me up and made me focus better than anything I have ever tried before. Now instead of taking my ADHD meds, which work but give me migraines, I usually just grab a cup of this instead. I'm about to finish up my first can and will definitely be purchasing another one. Whether looking for energy, focus, or both, this tea absolutely delivers! I cannot recommend it enough.
***Word of caution*** One cup is plenty to get you going; a little goes a LONG way. Two cups in a row made me a little jittery, dizzy, and gave me stomach pain."

i just got this cereal on a whim, i have been doing the low carb thing for a very long time (have lost 70lbs, thank you!) and gave up on cereal completely.  This stuff is pretty good, but VERY sweet. I eat it by putting it dry in a little ziplock sandwich bag and bring it to the gym for a post workout meal, good amount of protein, but the sugary taste will keep me from eating too much of it (one box at this rate will last me six months i bet. probably great with dried fruits for those in maintenance.

I desperately wanted my son to be exclusively breastfed, but lots of issues resulted in us having to supplement with formula from the time he was a week old. He's now a month old and eats mostly breastmilk but has 1-2 bottles per day of earth's best.

Pros: the formula does not seem to make him gassy, constipated, or otherwise uncomfortable. He doesn't mind the taste and goes back and forth between this formula and breastmilk without complaint. And, it's organic, which was a must for us.

Cons: it stinks!!!! I assume it's from the fish-derived DHA. This really is the only con. And it tastes absolutely nothing like breastmilk. That said, my son doesn't seem to mind, and that's what's most important.
Delicious and well packaged! It came right when it was supposed to. I love using this for baking and snacks!

Summary: jet fuel don't let the name scare you
Text:
They call it jet fuel but it has a nice taste , they use to call jet fuel the
stuff on the bottom coffee pot at the local greasy spoon but this is mellow compared to that stuff not a bad cup of Joe at all also it great buy !!

This was a nice starter pack containing all of Icio's water flavors.  I found the Lychee Watermelon to be very refreshing without being too sweet- this was probably my favorite.  The Apple Pear was more apple than pear, but I liked it too.  The Peach Ginger was much too strong for me.  Personally, the Cucumber Lemongrass tasted like grass and dirt-- I couldn't even stand to finish it.  I would order the Lychee Watermelon and Apple Pear only next time.  As far as the packing, a co-worker commented that it looked like I was drinking liquor from a flask instead of a bottled water.

These chips have great flavor as is but I am more into the buffalo wings flavor more than the bleu cheese flavor, but it's a combo that seems to work well, I probably would like it even more if it just had the heat and flavor of just the buffalo wing sauce. And you cannot beat the crunch on these.

Summary: Little expensive but the dogs love it.
Text:
We use these treats when we are going to be gone early and return late. It gives them something to do that they seem to enjoy.

I would like to use this more often but the price makes that impractical.

Please note that I think this product deserve 3 1/2 Stars rather than 4. But this is not star search and amazon wont let you.

I liked these KIND bars, between me, my gf, and company, we ate most of the whole box. It was a lot sweeter than I expected though.
Also, 3/4th into eating them, my jaws would get tired from chewing. I mean, I am not excessively chewing or anything, I am pretty sure I am using a normal mastication pace, but after eating a full bar, my mouth would be pretty tired. I think this bar is for diets or something.

I love green tea, so I am always on the lookout for different varieties.  I really like this tea.  If you let it steep for a while you get a nice taste of the ginger.  This is a great tea to start your morning with or for an afternoon drink.

Summary: good crunch, a little too sweet
Text:
I quite liked this product, but cannot give it five stars primarily for two reasons:

1. The chocolate flavor is a little too subtle. It would be better if the chocolate was darker/bittersweet to counterbalance the caramel.

2. Even for my sweet tooth, I find this product a little too sweet. Every kernel of popcorn is entirely covered with caramel and then drizzled with some cocoa mixture. To give you an idea, each 30 gram bag of this product has 18 grams of sugars.

Still, if I were in the mood for a sweet popcorn snack, I would consider purchasing this brand.
This is a great buy and a great product.  I use the sesame seeds in my cereal and in most items I bake. Highly recommend it.
I love the Maccha green tea Kit Kat. I'm not into chocolate so this is perfect. Would definitely order it again soon!

I ordered these yellow and white swirled lollipops for my daughter's birthday party and they were a big hit with the kids. They look exactly like the picture shows, however I had to take a star because they didn't taste like lemon at all.

Summary: Good Hot Chocolate - See Below for a Few Keurig Brewing Tips for Cocoa
Text:
This is a pretty good cocoa for your Kuerig brewer, and has a nice and rich taste at the "small" setting of my Keurig: if you want a less-rich experience, just try the medium or the large setting as there will be more water vs. the flavoring than the small. My son and I like it at the small setting, while my wife and daughter prefer the medium setting (none of us cared for the large setting). Don't forget to add the marshmellows!

One trick to getting a better experience for the hot chocolate in your Keurig is before you put the pod in the Keurig, make sure you shake the pod real well in order to break up the clumps of the cocoa powder: you need to do this as it tends to clump (no matter what brand of K-cup hot cocoa) and breaking the clumps up allows you to draw out more of the flavor vs. more of the hot water. After all, you paid a lot for the cocoa!

One thing I do after brewing each cup of cocoa is to run a medium setting of hot water in order to clean the Keurig by just raising and lowering the pod holder and closing it without a pod into it and then running a medium cup cycle: make sure you put an empty cup under the unit, and you will see what I mean as some of the cocoa powder gets in to the Keurig's lines. Once you flush it out, just discard this dirty water (you'll be surprised). I highly recommend this as, for example, if the next thing you brew is coffee you don't want to have a hint of cocoa in your coffee.

The one-star deduction is because these bags easily rip and puncture. Be careful when you are tearing each bag off as you can easily rip the bottom of the next bag on the roll. And don't even try to use that hole at the top of the bag; I'm not even sure what that hole is for. If you try to follow the diagram for closing the bag, the hole will tear open. Hopefully it will tear towards the top and not towards the bottom. Just tie a knot at the top and ignore that diagram. Also, if you drop a full bag on the sidewalk, it's very possible to put tiny holes in the bag when it hits the sand in the sidewalk cement. Summary: Product Comparison - Premium wins on Ingredients, Analysis and Price!
Text:
I'm going to preface this review by saying that my kitties are not picky about food. We've made sure to expose them to a variety of dry and wet foods since they were very young, and they are usually willing to try new things. That being said, they loved this food and took to it with no problems at all. I mixed it 50/50 with their old food (a mid-range name brand), but I didn't even need to.

I compared the ingredients and guaranteed analysis in Premium Edge to our current dry food, Purina One Hairball and also Taste of the Wild which I was considering purchasing as well. I found the ingredients in Premium Edge much better than Purina and, in my opinion, even a smidge better than Taste of the Wild. For example, PE's first 4 ingredients are: Chicken, chicken meal, peas, egg product (also a good source of protein for kitties). ToW's first 4 ingredients are: Chicken meal, peas, sweet potatoes, chicken fat. Purina's are: Chicken, corn gluten meal, brewers rice, poultry by-product meal. No comparison there. I'd much rather feed my cats a dry food that at least has some "real" chicken in it, although chicken meal isn't as bad as some people think it is -- it's just ground up meat and other bits like bone and tissue (which they would eat in a wild or raw diet anyway!) Then there's the guaranteed analysis to consider. More protein is always better, since cats are obligate carnivores and would not eat carbs if they had their choice. PE wins with 45% protein, followed by Tow at 42% then Purina One with only 34%.

And finally price... Price per pound based on Amazon price: Premium Edge 18 lb. bag was $1.46/lb., ToW 15 lb. bag was $2.26/lb., and Purina One was $1.59/lb. for 16 lb. bag. So again, Premium Edge came out on top. This is what I will be buying from now on, until I finally bite the bullet and move my brood to a wet food only or a full-on raw food diet.

Summary: Definitely different and a nice change from salted nuts
Text:
I really like Emerald nuts, and have been buying their smoked almonds and cashews a while. These cocoa roast almonds preserve much of what I like about Emerald nuts - freshness, not too much oil, high quality - but are more of a semi-sweet snack instead of a salty one.

Their sweetness doesn't come from sugar, though. They are sweetened lightly with sucralose (the sweetener sold under the brand name Splenda).

Note that the product doesn't contain chocolate, though it's described as "dark chocolate flavor". The cocoa is roasted into the surface of the nut, but the almonds are not coated in chocolate. The good part about that is that they don't make a mess, and they're a better choice for someone who is trying to avoid sweets. But I'm sure some have bought these expecting to get chocolate and were disappointed.

I liked them enough that I'll get them again, especially when I need something to cut the craving for chocolate candy. They have just enough chocolate flavor to do that, while having only one gram of sugars per serving.

They're not as big and thick as some of the bully sticks we buy locally, but the 7-inch sticks we buy locally cost $5 or more. Overall for a $1 a stick, you can't beat it. Our dog loves them as much as she loves her treats.

Summary: Highly Recommend but Did not Work for my Dog
Text:
I love Castor and Pollux Organix dog food as I have done much research and it seems to be the best of the best. It is expensive, but all of the top quality foods run around the same price and this one falls into that category. They have so many important factors such as organic chicken with no added growth hormones or antibiotics, the kibble is small and my dog found it to be tasty, and it is made in the USA (which is important because it contains chicken and there has been many dog food recalls that contain chicken made in China).

As much as I love this product, I am sad to report that it did not agree with my Cavalier King Charles Spaniel puppy. I gradually introduced Organix mixing it with his previous food (Halo)over the span of 2 weeks and his stools were consistently soft. Every once in awhile he would have a "normal" stool but for the most part either had soft stools and occasional liquid diarrhea. I kept him on the food for a month, after being on Halo 3 months (he had the same problem with soft stools on Halo), hoping that his system would get used to it but never did. I encourage anyone else who is trying new foods and their dog's stool does not become normal within a couple of weeks to change foods (and different types of meat in the food) instead of waiting to see if it will work out because the ongoing soft stools led to another issue for my dog.

Because he had soft stools for a long time we went to the vet to get him tested for worms, other potential issues and the results came back normal except for his anal glands. Apparently a dog's individual scent comes from the glands on their butt (that is why dogs sniff each other there). The scent is in a brown liquid that comes out of the anal glands on their butt every time they defecate. However, if they have soft stool on a regular basis, that liquid is not pushed out by an otherwise normal stool and the glands can become backed up/clogged causing all kinds of other issues that if not taken care of could need surgery. A sign that your dog might be clogged is if they scooch their butt on the floor. Thankfully his was not to the point of needing surgery and the vet was easily able to get the liquid out (which some of it had dried up and formed hard chunks that caused pain and irritation). I only mention this in case this information could be potentially helpful to any of my fellow pet parents. :)

After trying Organix,Halo, Wellness, boiled chicken and rice, plain ground beef and rice (all high quality foods), I decided to try him on a hypoallergenic food and he has finally been having consistently normal stools on a regular basis (the last month) for the first time since we have had him!!! We suspect that he may have had stomach irritation with the meats chicken and beef (more common than I realized after some research).

The food that I currently have him on is Nature's Variety Instinct Duck & Turkey meal formula. He doesn't like the taste of the food as much as the others so we mix each meal with a small amount of natures variety instinct canned duck formula and he loves it. Although canned foods can be just as high quality as dry foods as far as quality ingredients go, they can cause tarter build-up on the teeth more quickly if you are not brushing the dogs teeth on a regular basis.

Since Nature's Variety brand is considered hypoallergenic we introduced him to the salmon formula (mixing a very small amount in with his duck food) and it caused soft stool again so if your dog has a sensitive stomach...try duck! Otherwise, Organix is the best food you can buy for your dog as far as quality goes and it I highly recommend it!!! I also highly recommend looking at dog food reviews on the website: dogfoodadvisor.com so that you can know how to read dog food labels and what to look out for!

The product was true to its label in that I was able to study with concentration from 12 o'clock to 5 with no "afternoon slump" or "jitters"(though for a time I did experience a subtle tingling in my fingers). When my five hours were up, I came back to normal and didn't feel any side effects or "caffeine crash". The product is not addictive: I bought a pack of twelve bottles a month ago and still haven't used them all.

5-hour energy should be used with wisdom, however -- the manufacturers say that it contains "no more caffeine than a cup of coffee" but doesn't specify the size of the cup. It took me an hour longer than normal to get to sleep when I drank a whole bottle.

That said, I have no other complaints to offer of this excellent energy drink. I suggest taking half of a bottle whenever you need a boost of concentration or motivation, as that is usually sufficient. Also, drink these only when you need to -- it's potent stuff, and I wager those little bottles can disappear quickly.

5-hour energy is a great resource for workouts, daily business, and the hurly-burly of modern life. I give it 4 stars.

Summary: Light, Crisp and Good--Just a Little Too Sweet
Text:
I'm not a sweets eater, preferring starchy salty things for snacks, but I crave a little something sweet every now and then. The little 100-calorie packs of other sweets are a good choice for me, because they are just small, low-calorie packs of sweet things to eat. Here recently, I've gone to eating gluten-free and all-natural, so I don't really eat this type of food any more. I preface my review with that, so everyone is clear that this isn't my normal type of food when I am judging a rating on it, and my rating might be affected by the fact I usually don't eat processed foods. My daughter bought two boxes of these the other day--and cinnamon and brown sugar are two flavors I really love for the limited sweets I do eat--so she let me have one.

They are very sweet. For me, they are too sweet... way too sweet. But for someone who likes sweets, I would imagine they are just the perfect amount of sweetness. What I really liked about them was the crispy, flakiness. They have this nice softish outer shell of pastry, but this nice, crisp, brittleness that makes them crunchy too. In flavor, they are like a thin, crispy pop tart. It's like all the good stuff of a pop tart without all the 'excess' pastry that pop tarts have that I don't like. I love the crispness.

My BFF tried the chocolate ones and said it was very good and didn't have any powder 'fake' chocolate taste that some chocolate products have. She liked the crispiness of it too.

So if you're a sweets eater, these small little pop-tart-like treats are probably going to be the perfect little snack item and if you can bring yourself to eat only one package of them (there are two small 'sticks' or 'bars' in each interior package), then it's only 100-calories and might fit in well with a low-calorie and/or low-fat diet plans too. They are not, however, good for low-carbing or Paleo or all-natural diets. For older kids and teenagers, they are probably a great slightly healthier substitution for pop tarts too.

Summary: A lower calorie alternative to standard chips: 120 calories/oz. A bit flavorless in native state but good when flavored
Text:
The eternal dieter's quest: A replacement for oily, fatty, and oh-so-addictive real potato chips. Sure, you can get the baked versions, but they lack a bit in both the crunch and flavor categories. And they cost a lot.

So the quest continues. I got a case of these PopChips, cheddar flavor, through Amazon, inspired by a good sale and thoughts of "there must be something better".

The first thing I noticed was the calorie count: A substantial 3oz bag of these chips (a lunch bag is 1oz) has only 360 calories (120 calories per "serving"), of which 35 are fat calories. Those are better numbers than tradition potato chips, which run around 160 calories for a 1oz serving, and which get 80-90 of those calories from fat. (Calorie counts can vary dramatically upward depending on the chips, but these numbers are typical). Better--and this is where the calories don't tell the whole story--a 1 oz serving feels larger, because these PopChips are puffed larger.

But don't let that word "puff" scare you. They DO have a major non puffy tasting solid crunch to them. The flavor is also pretty good and the best part: Look Ma, no orange crap on my hands! That's a big plus for a cheddar flavored chip...Take that Cheetos!

I liked the cheddar ones so much, I ordered the BBQ ones as well, and they're even better tasting (IMHO).

One thing to note: These are low(er) fat, low(er) calories, but not low sodium. A 1oz portion has 290mg of sodium (12% of the recommended daily intake for a normal person). If you are on a salt restricted diet, or if you don't like salt, think twice...

On the whole, these are good, tasty, and most importantly, satisfying, while at the same time less caloric (and much less fatty) than standard potato chips. They are saltier than many would prefer, but presuming you are not on a salt restricted diet, they'll be OK. As a bonus, they are supposed "all natural". Personally, I don't care about that last point, but it's certainly not a bad thing!

One last thing: You will find some diets that claim it's not the calories, it's the source of the calories. Hogwash. It IS the calories. No chip is diet worthy in big quantities. Consider the calories and your total caloric intake, and make the personal decision whether these make sense.

Try them yourself...Amazon offers a sampler package with multiple varieties, and that might be the best way to sample them.

Calories per serving: Veggie M&C 370 Regular M&C 400
Calories from fat: Veggie 140 Regular 170
Sodium %: Veggie 28% Regular 30%
Fiber grams: Veggie 3g Regular 1g
Sugar grams: Veggie 7g Regular 6 g

Our three cats don't love this "dental diet cat food" as much at the round balls but they do eat it along with their other food. I buy only grain free Orijen and another dry cat food intended for indoor cats. Our cats enjoy the variety and it does seem to work. The Science Diet has an almost greasy coating on the surface but this seems to draw our cats to it. The size and shape forces them to chew it and this is good for their teeth. We have one cat that loves to swallow his cat food without chewing. How he does it when it's dry, I don't know! I believe that the larger size alone means healthier teeth and gums for our cats. Two of our cats (9 yrs old) are of a breed that is known to suffer from gum diease. They have healthy gums. I believe that a dental diet cat food helps to prevent gum disease....and the larger size provides variety to their diet that they enjoy. Not everything a cat eats has to be 100% certified good for them. Can you imagine if we always ate only healthy food! Boring! If you provide a good quality dry cat food, plenty of water (we use a fountain), routine exercise (play with them!) and a canned cat food as a treat now and then....you will have healthy and happy cats.

Summary: Evidently tasty dog food, but high in carbs, fillers
Text:
I have for some years now been feeding my dog a blend of appetizing dog foods with a costly prescription diet for his medical condition. He doesn't always have much of an appetite, and it can be difficult to coax him into eating much. He won't eat the prescription diet unless there's something a little more tempting with it. I don't know; maybe once he gets started he doesn't pay as much attention to the individual elements.

On opportunity for review, I picked this up along with a bag of Chef Michael's Grilled Sirloin Dry Dog Food to see how these two foods would work for this purpose, and how they'd compare.

Either of them does the trick. He was enticed by the smell of the Beneful before I even opened the bag. Put a few pieces on the floor, and he went after it like a dog in a dog food commercial. He gave pretty much the same attention to the Chef Michael's. He doesn't seem much to care which I put in the bowl with the prescription food; he has so far chowed down on each just as happily.

Even allowing for the lower portion sizes of Chef Michael, it costs twice as much. Nutritionally, there are some differences between the pair. Beneful has 25% crude protein (minimum); 10% crude fat (minimum); 4% crude fiber (maximum) and a maximum of 14% moisture. Chef Michael has 28% crude protein (minimum); 16% crude fat (minimum); 3% crude fiber (maximum) and a maximum of 12% moisture. I've been doing some reading on dog food ingredients, and while I'm no expert what I've read suggests that the Beneful is heavy on carbs and, while its top protein source (chicken by product; second on the list) is a decent protein, it's not necessarily a highly digestible food due to its heavy reliance on corn. Chef Michael starts with beef.

That considered, I'm not sure that the Beneful would be my first choice for mixing in with my dog's food, although in the right proportion I feel comfortable enough with it. With his tricky health, I don't think I would use either of these solely, but they both do the trick. While neither is exactly a health food, I can't pretend that everything I eat is the healthiest option, either. These are decent supplements, but I personally would not use them as mainstays.

Summary: Great for fish tacos and chicken dishes.
Text:
I had the opportunity to sample and evaluate 3 different flavors of Taco Bell's bottled sauces. These were the Jalapeno, Chipotle and Spicey Ranchero flavors. Of the 3, I personally liked the Jalapeno flavor the most with the Spicey Ranchero coming in a close second. The flavors are bold so a little sauce goes a long way.

I approached this evaluation from the standpoint that these sauces are condiments, like ketchup or mustard, and not just sauces that you might put on your tacos and burritos. That said, I tasted each flavor on fish sticks with pleasant results. The only sauce I did NOT like on them was the Chipotle sauce, which I feel might be better suited to dishes that include beef. The Jalapeno and Spicy Ranchero both work really well with fish (and would be great for fish tacos) as well as chicken. Used as a condiment, these sauces can add a new flavor experience to everything from deli sandwiches to casseroles. I added about 2 tbsp of the Spicey Ranchero to a batch of left over rice along with some cheese and a bit of sour cream to make a great side dish. A lot of recipes that call for mayo might be livened up or rejuvenated with a measure of your favorite sauce.
